en: Vintage monochrome postcard showing a Russian naval minelayer/transport ship at sea, with two tall smokestacks emitting dark smoke and a naval ensign flying at the stern. Printed German text beneath the image identifies the vessel as the minelayer transport ship "Jenissei". There is a handwritten annotation in blue ink in Russian across the lower part of the picture. Publisher and photographer credits in German appear at the bottom margin, mentioning Reval.
